    Parse SLF snow height data

    parse_slf_snow.Rd

    Source: https://public-meas-data-v2.slf.ch/public/station-data/timepoint/SNOW_HEIGHT/current/geojson Description: -

    parse_slf_snow(p = NULL, remote = FALSE, id.var = "snow")

    Arguments

    p

    File path or URL

    remote

    Load from remote (URL)

    id.var

    Identifier variable (e. g. "tt" for air temperature)

    Value

    data table

    Author

    M. Saenger

    Examples

    parse_slf_snow(remote=TRUE, id.var="tt")
